title: Google Cloud outage · 12 June 2025
notes: Selected systems, products and locations from the provider report. The global scope groups report entries, not individual deployments.
Updates describe the scope reported by Google. Product and region highlights follow the available milestones. This replay contains no request measurements.
The early incident report times the start at 17:49 UTC. The status dashboard dates the public incident from 17:51 UTC.

events.title: Quota policy update
events.detail: Around this time a policy update entered the regional Spanner tables and replicated globally. Google later identified blank fields in the update.

events.title: Service Control starts failing
events.detail: Service Control entered crash loops across regions. Google reported more HTTP 503 responses on external APIs across multiple products.

events.title: Core mitigation outside Iowa
events.detail: Google reported mitigation outside us-central1. Restarts in Iowa overloaded the regional Spanner policy store.

events.title: Overload in Iowa
events.detail: Service Control recovery in us-central1 lagged while the policy store was overloaded.

events.title: Core API serving recovered
events.detail: The incident report places recovery of Service Control and API serving across all regions around this time. Some products continued recovering.

events.title: Residual product impact
events.detail: The status update continued to list impact on products including Cloud Dataflow and Vertex AI Online Prediction.

events.title: Cloud Dataflow recovered
events.detail: Google later reported Cloud Dataflow recovery at this time.

events.title: Vertex AI was the remaining impact
events.detail: The 17:33 PDT update identified Vertex AI Online Prediction as the remaining impact.

events.title: Two Vertex AI regions still affected
events.detail: The 17:59 PDT update named europe-west1 and asia-southeast1 as still restoring normal Vertex AI serving capacity.

events.title: Full recovery reported
events.detail: Google's final status update put Vertex AI Online Prediction recovery at 18:18 PDT and confirmed recovery for all affected products.
